what_it_does.title: Everything your venue needs to fly.
what_it_does.subtitle: An integrated suite of tools designed specifically for the fast-paced hospitality industry.
what_it_does.feature1_desc: Take orders from any smartphone, tablet, or POS terminal. Touch interface optimized to dispatch drinks and dishes in under 3 seconds.
what_it_does.feature2_desc: View the status of your bar, terrace, and dining room at a glance. Assign tables, merge orders, move guests, and manage payments error-free.
what_it_does.feature3_desc: Automatic ticket routing to thermal kitchen & bar printers or pantry screens. Zero lost tickets or unreadable hand-written notes.
what_it_does.feature4_desc: Complete catalog of products, categories, ingredients, and modifiers. Get automatic alerts when products or drinks run low.
what_it_does.feature5_desc: Plan waiter and kitchen staff shifts, assign custom permission roles, and track clock-ins and worked hours seamlessly.
what_it_does.feature6_desc: Daily automated reporting in one click: revenue breakdown by card/cash, top-selling items, peak hours, and accounting exports.

use_cases.with_item4: One-click register closing with 100% accurate sales and stock data.
use_cases.bars_desc: One-tap bar orders. Speed up drink rounds and quick payments during peak rush hours.
use_cases.restaurants_desc: Manage appetizers, main courses, and desserts. Send kitchen notifications and sync terrace table maps.
use_cases.cafes_desc: Fast self-service or table checkout, custom breakfast items, and low stock bakery alerts.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is the FREE Plan really free forever?
faq.a1: Yes, 100%. The FREE Plan lets you manage 1 bar and up to 100 orders per month at no cost, with no credit card required at sign-up.
faq.q2: Do I need to buy special hardware or POS terminals?
faq.a2: No. Coaster runs as a modern Web App on any smartphone, Android/iOS tablet, or PC/laptop you already own.
faq.q3: Can I connect my current kitchen ticket printers?
faq.a3: Yes. Coaster connects via our local network printer service to standard thermal printers (Epson, Star, Bixolon, etc.).
faq.q4: Can I upgrade from the FREE Plan to the PRO Plan anytime?
faq.a4: Yes. You can start with the FREE Plan and upgrade to Barra PRO anytime from your panel to unlock unlimited orders and printers.
faq.q5: Can I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime?
faq.a5: Absolutely. You can update, pause, or cancel your subscription anytime with a single click from your billing panel.
